description: This file defines the DataRepository class, which abstracts data storage for recipe data, choosing between Room database and SharedPreferences fallback depending on availability. It provides suspend functions for CRUD operations related to recipes.

classes.name: DataRepository
classes.description: Manages access to recipe data, selecting between Room database and fallback storage, exposing suspend functions for data operations.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all recipes, using Room if available, otherwise fallback storage.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Searches recipes matching the query string.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a recipe by its ID.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new recipe and returns its ID.

methods.name: toggleFavorite
methods.description: Toggles the favorite status of a recipe by ID.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Singleton factory method for obtaining a DataRepository instance.
